Copies the beatmaps and scores you have in **osu!lazer** to **osu!stable**, only the ones stable doesn't have yet.

**Download `Exotique.exe` below and run it.** Nothing to install, Windows 10/11 64-bit.
Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" because the exe isn't code-signed: click **More info** → **Run anyway**.

**New in 2.3: scores**
- Your lazer scores go to stable's Local leaderboard, with their replays. `scores.db` is backed up first and nothing is removed.
- **Beatmaps** and **Scores** each have a checkbox: copy only your scores if your maps are already in stable.
- A score whose map isn't in stable is copied together with its map.
- Scores played in lazer show lazer's "Classic" score; stable recalculates accuracy and rank, and their replays may play back a little differently.
- Other players' replays you downloaded in lazer are left out unless you include them.

Also: lazer is never modified, maps as folders or `.osz`, lazer collections merged into `collection.db`, a running osu! is detected and can be closed for you. English, Français, Русский.

After copying, launch osu!stable and press **F5** in song select for new maps. Your scores are in the **Local Ranking** leaderboard.

---

**FR** · Copie vers osu!stable les maps et les scores de osu!lazer qu'il n'a pas encore. Nouveau : les scores vont dans le classement Local avec leur replay (scores.db sauvegardé avant). Décoche « Beatmaps » pour ne copier que les scores. Si Windows bloque : **Informations complémentaires** → **Exécuter quand même**.

**RU** · Копирует в osu!stable карты и рекорды из osu!lazer, которых там ещё нет. Новое: рекорды попадают в локальную таблицу вместе с реплеями (scores.db сохраняется заранее). Сними отметку с «Карты», чтобы скопировать только рекорды. Если Windows блокирует: **Подробнее** → **Выполнить в любом случае**.
